parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, typically small and cylindrical in shape.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator for dispensing liquid when pressed, controlling the flow of the contents from the bottle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position after release due to internal spring or pressure mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of HDPE plastic, cylindrical with a slightly tapered shape.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the liquid or gel content and provides structural support for the lid and dispensing mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, only being tilted or squeezed slightly depending on the design.
